title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final relation between Delta p, phi, and r.

title: Energy Minimization
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the principle of minimum free energy applied to the problem.

title: Pressure Difference
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly express the pressure difference in terms of the internal and external pressures.

title: Mathematical Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should show the steps leading to the derivation of the final equation.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that the units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the pressure difference.

title: Assumptions Clarification
description: Optional Criteria: The student should clarify any assumptions made regarding the phases of air inside and outside the bubble.

title: Alternative Approaches
description: Optional Criteria: The student may mention alternative methods to derive the same relation.
